verdict.rationale: Jules's main work product is pushed to the user's own GitHub repositories as standard git PRs. That leaves code changes in an open, portable format, so leaving Jules costs little for code [jules-docs-1, jules-docs-8]. A public API also exists for working with sessions programmatically [jules-docs-9], but nothing shows a data-export feature for anything beyond code. Missing for 10: a documented account/data export (session history, plans, conversations, settings), stated open export formats, an account-deletion or offboarding process, and independent corroboration of portability.
